SF.reason: Lettered satellite craters (7,063 rows such as “Tycho A”) repeat their parent crater’s name with a letter; the label layer keeps the parent names and leaves the lettered satellites to the Gazetteer.

AL.reason: Telescopic albedo features carry no Gazetteer diameter and describe historic shading, not mapped landforms.
